description: This file contains implementation of WiFi database management functions, including initialization, configuration updates, and retrieval of WiFi parameters. It supports both default and custom configurations for radios, VAPs, and other WiFi components, with conditional compilation for support of ONEWIFI_DB_SUPPORT.
